finding: FEMA workforce shortages: a large share of deployed staff not qualified for their positions across concurrent disasters
concurrent disasters (Harvey, Irma, Maria, wildfires) drew on the same contractor and commodity pools; capacity allocated by contract rather than by declared need
Puerto Rico: damaged ports, roads and power delayed distribution from staging to points of distribution
local government capacity in Puerto Rico and USVI limited; FEMA took on functions normally performed by local nodes
